text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро МакКуин has been steadily
building up
her strength.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
As a stayer, her mind is set on winning
two
particular races in her classic year:
the Kikuka Sho
and its prelude, the
Kobe Shimbun Hai.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She proclaims her desire to keep in good
form
and remain focused through her
progress forward.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
